recommendation: Keep this commit as the narrow FHIR-50489 fix. Handle FHIR-50488 supplementalData and broader future DEQM composition proposals separately because they are distinct requests.
issue_request: FHIR-50489 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R6. It requested additional multi-part stratifier parameters on Measure $evaluate, plus a MeasureReport.inputParameters SHALL when input stratifiers are supplied; the approved stratifier.component.criteria parameter was 0..1.
initial_application: PR HL7/fhir#3811, commit 7386aa83a9, added the stratifier parameter and MeasureReport.inputParameters text. Commit 4cb65bc7ea then fixed the nested multi-part structure. Later commits a313c05421 and c751acd79a added/clarified criteria wording but left the operation parameter cardinality stricter than the Jira resolution and the corresponding Measure element.
additional_context: Measure and MeasureReport are active in source/fhir.ini and the Measure operations list references OperationDefinition/Measure-evaluate, so the edited XML is current build source. FHIR-50488 is the same operation enhancement family for supplementalData, and FHIR-50484, FHIR-53139, FHIR-53433, and FHIR-51028 are later nearby changes, but none decides that additional stratifier component criteria should be mandatory.
reconciliation: Changed source/measure/operationdefinition-Measure-evaluate.xml so stratifier.component.criteria has min 0 and max 1. The existing stratifier parameter, MeasureReport.inputParameters rule, later criteria documentation, and measureUrl 1..* cardinality were preserved.
